Connect a business to another tool. `GET /v1/integrations` lists every integration and what it needs. A **push** integration (an affiliate program, for example) is connected with its credentials through the routes below: each matching billing event becomes one call to the partner, retried with backoff, with a delivery log per connection. A **sync** integration (HubSpot) has its own routes.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/list-integrations-with-this-business-s-status) | List integrations with this business's status |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/get-a-push-integration-s-connection) | Get a push integration's connection |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/enable) | Enable, disable, replace credentials or change settings |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/disconnect-a-push-integration) | Disconnect a push integration |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}/connect`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/connect-a-push-integration) | Connect a push integration |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}/deliveries`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/list-a-connection-s-deliveries) | List a connection's deliveries |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}/deliveries/{delivery}/redeliver`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/resend-one-delivery-now) | Resend one delivery now |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}/redeliver_failed`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/requeue-every-failed-delivery) | Requeue every failed delivery |
| `GET` | [`/v1/integrations`](/help/developers/api-reference/integrations/list-the-integrations-this-deployment-can-connec) | List the integrations this deployment can connect |
